scenarios.name: deals-lifecycle
scenarios.about: a pipeline and its stages are configuration (/meta/v1), a deal sits in one stage ([[CORE130]]): a duplicate stage name is 409 stage_exists, the pipeline follows the stage, a move to won sets closed_at and emits deal.stage_changed, back to open clears it, a stage holding a deal cannot be deleted (409 stage_in_use), and status is derived and filterable

error.message: a stage named "CONTACTED" already exists in this pipeline (0190b2c4-0000-7000-8000-000001000007)
kind cannot be changed after creation
an amount needs a currency: send currency with amount_minor
stage_id cannot be changed after creation; use deals.move_stage to change the stage
stage "Won" holds 1 live deal (0190b2c4-0000-7000-8000-000001000013); move or delete them first
pipeline "Prospecting" holds 1 live deal (0190b2c4-0000-7000-8000-000001000013); move or delete them first

scenarios.name: deals-linking
scenarios.about: a deal links to companies and tags through associations ([[CORE130]] D14, [[CORE136]]): deals.list?company_id= and ?tag_id= return the linked deals, a deal cannot link to another deal or to an interaction (400, the allowed types are named), a deleted edge leaves the filter, deals.get?include=associations embeds the live edges, and deleting a deal cascades its edges
